up: Retrieve distinct compounds tested against the target Prelamin-A/C (ChEMBL ID: CHEMBL1293235) in human assays. Return the compound's ChEMBL ID and its canonical SMILES. Filter assays to only include those where the assay organism is 'Homo sapiens'. Join activities with target_dictionary on tid to apply the target filter, and join with compound_structures to obtain the canonical SMILES. Ensure each qualifying compound appears exactly once in the output.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1293235' AND ass.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'
